LanguageData.CER_Ingredients_Subtitle: Build reusable Equipment Packs here - one pack can hold medicine, food, drugs and utility items together. Weapons are picked per colonist in Equip Colonists; attach packs to colonists or roles there once you have some.
LanguageData.CER_Ingredients_AutoGenerateTip: Build a whole starter palette at once - everyday supply, a medic kit, a shield kit - with sliders for cost/weight/threat. Every item is editable right there before you generate, and again afterwards on the left.
LanguageData.CER_Ingredients_DeletePackConfirm: Delete the equipment pack "{0}"? Colonists currently carrying it will lose these items.
LanguageData.CER_Ingredients_SelectPackPrompt: Select an Equipment Pack on the left, or create a new one.
LanguageData.CER_Ingredients_OtherSectionHint: For anything outside the categories above - opens CE's own loadout editor for this pack.
